description:
Price and sales history for one skin on each marketplace. The skin's history on every marketplace rust.wiki tracks, Steam included. Per site in `sites`:
`listing` is `[day, low, close, qty]` per UTC day - the lowest listing price we read that day (`low` the day's
lowest reading, `close` the last) and how many listings stood behind it; `sales` maps a period to
`[day, volume, avg_price]` rows - `day` and `week` are real sales buckets (DMarket's own sales graph, `day` =
the bucket's first day), `r7` and `r30` a site's rolling 7- and 30-day sales figures as we read them that day
(Skinport, Rust.tm, CS.Deals and TradeRust only publish those). Prices are integer USD cents. Listing history
starts 2026-10-30; DMarket sales go back about a year (weekly) and two months (daily). Steam's own sale history
is GET /skins/{itemdefid}/history. Updated through the day (listings every ~5 minutes).
name: get_skin_marketplace_history
title: Price and sales history for one skin on each marketplace
